metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience over 65 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need rainfall data for two Australian towns in Queensland around late Jan–early Feb 2019. ERA5-Land hourly dataset has total_precipitation band (units: meters). GPM IMERG Final (daily) is another option but ERA5-Land is global, gap-free, and quick to compute, so we’ll start with it. Date window: 2019-01-27 to 2019-02-10 inclusive (15 days). 2. Location: Mount Isa ≈ 20.7°S 139.5°E Townsville ≈ 19.3°S 146.8°E Create small buffered points (~5 km) to ensure we sample several pixels. 3. Processing: - Sum total_precipitation over the 15 days (ERA5-Land scale 0.1° ≈ 11 km). - Convert meters → centimeters (×100). - Check collection size; if 0 → C1. - After sum, check pixel count; if 0 → C2. - If result is None/NaN → C3. - If either region ≥ 65 cm → A, else B. 4. Output: print summed rainfall (cm) and pixel counts for both places, then the tag. import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Locations & period isa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.5, -20.7]).buffer(5000) town = ee.Geometry.Point([146.8, -19.3]).buffer(5000) start, end = '2019-01-27', '2019-02-10' # 2. Rainfall collection (ERA5-Land) pr = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \ .select('total_precipitation') \ .filterDate(start, end) if pr.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No ERA5-Land images found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Sum precipitation (meters → cm) total_pr = pr.sum().multiply(100) # cm scale = 10000 # ERA5-Land native ~0.1° (~11 km); 10 km safe isa_cm = total_pr.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=isa, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('total_precipitation').getInfo() town_cm = total_pr.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=town, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('total_precipitation').getInfo() # 4. Validation if isa_cm is None or town_cm is None: print("C3") exit() isa_ok = (isa_cm is not None) and (isa_cm >= 0) town_ok = (town_cm is not None) and (town_cm >= 0) if not (isa_ok and town_ok): print("C3") exit() # 5. Report & decide print(f"Mount Isa rainfall: {isa_cm:.1f} cm") print(f"Townsville rainfall: {town_cm:.1f} cm") if isa_cm >= 65 or town_cm >= 65: print("A") else: print("B")
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Locations & period
isa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.5, -20.7]).buffer(5000)
town = ee.Geometry.Point([146.8, -19.3]).buffer(5000)
start, end = '2019-01-27', '2019-02-10'

# 2. Rainfall collection (ERA5-Land)
pr = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \
        .select('total_precipitation') \
        .filterDate(start, end)

if pr.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No ERA5-Land images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Sum precipitation (meters → cm)
total_pr = pr.sum().multiply(100)  # cm
scale = 10000  # ERA5-Land native ~0.1° (~11 km); 10 km safe
isa_cm = total_pr.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                               geometry=isa, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) \
                  .get('total_precipitation').getInfo()
town_cm = total_pr.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                geometry=town, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) \
                   .get('total_precipitation').getInfo()

# 4. Validation
if isa_cm is None or town_cm is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()
isa_ok = (isa_cm is not None) and (isa_cm >= 0)
town_ok = (town_cm is not None) and (town_cm >= 0)
if not (isa_ok and town_ok):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

# 5. Report & decide
print(f"Mount Isa rainfall: {isa_cm:.1f} cm")
print(f"Townsville rainfall: {town_cm:.1f} cm")
if isa_cm >= 65 or town_cm >= 65:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
